title: Avis
locator: Sections IV-C1/2, equations 1 and profiling-state definitions
finding: Safety/liveliness monitors compare position, acceleration and mode with profiling runs; configuration-specific recovery coverage is not established by these sections.

title: aerial-autonomy-stack
finding: Gazebo Harmonic, both autopilots and distinct middleware bridges are described. Evaluate reuse; a common interface does not establish event equivalence.

title: PX4 Offboard
finding: ROS2 OffboardControlMode liveness is separate from trajectory setpoints; cessation of each is a distinct injection.

title: ArduPilot GCS failsafe
locator: When the failsafe will trigger; What will happen
finding: GCS heartbeat loss triggers configured actions only after monitoring is active. Restored heartbeat does not itself restore the previous flight mode.

title: EP3662460B1
finding: Emergency return via a healthy communication waypoint and waiting for user command after reconnect are disclosed. Generic reconnect handling is not a novelty claim.
